markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (83%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged Tier 3 for low reliability and cross-model disagreement despite 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 83%, Normal 17%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 46% reliability (flagged), 88th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Suspect input; recut and levels drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign, 2/5 Normal (60% agreement, 88% similarity) [F5] | Split between Benign and Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.73, contrib -1.14) indicates scarce stromal invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.51, contrib -0.55), though caption-inconsistent [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 2) · context · Below-typical score (+0.09, contrib +0.42); descriptive only (8/20 spot check) [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 3, 9, 11) · context · 66% neoplastic nuclei (96th percentile), high shape variation and TIL proximity [F7] [F8] [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (deletion drop +0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132); all 12 regions score 0 here.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); discount unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Low reliability (46%, 88th OOD percentile) masks neoplasia in regions 3, 9, 11 (48–70 segmented neoplastic nuclei each).
- Tissue is Normal (17% probability; 2/5 neighbors, including contrast case BACH_0175 differing in invasion and duct_confined).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 9, 11**: Verify whether 48–70 HoVer-Net neoplastic nuclei per region reflect benign proliferation or atypia.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 8, 7**: Confirm benign tubules (regions 4, 5, 8) versus duct-confined atypia (region 7).
3. **Regions 0–11**: Check slide quality for artifacts and decide on drafted H&E recut or deeper levels.
